title: Vampirism Fluid Blood Conversion data map
description: NeoForge data map `vampirism:fluid_blood_conversion` (de.teamlapen.vampirism.common.datamaps.FluidBloodConversion). File location: data/<namespace>/data_maps/fluid/fluid_blood_conversion.json. Sets the ratio the Blood Sieve uses to turn a fluid into blood: output = conversionRate * input_amount.

replace.description: If true, clears all previously loaded entries before applying `values`.

values.description: Maps a fluid id (or a `#fluid_tag`) to a conversion entry.

remove.description: Fluid ids (or `#fluid_tags`) to remove from the merged map.

idOrTag.description: A namespaced id, or a tag reference prefixed with `#`.

entry.description: Fraction of the input fluid amount returned as blood. Bare number or an object.

conversionRate.description: Fraction of the input fluid amount returned as blood. 0 = no conversion.
